English: Whereas invasions in South Africa’s natural systems are strongly structured by biotic and abiotic features of the region’s biomes, the imprint of these features is much less marked in urban ecosystems that exist as islands of human-dominated and highly modified habitat.

Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale, batho ba bona bohlokwa bja tše dingwe tša diphedi tše ka ge di fana ka methopo ye bohlokwa, ya go swana le dikgong tša tša mollo.
Amharic: በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ ለሰዎች እንደ ለእሳት የሚሆን እንጨት ያሉ ጠቃሚ ሀብቶችን ስለሚሰጡ ለእነዚህ እንዳንድ ወራሪ ዝርያዎች ሰዎች ዋጋም ይሰጣሉ።

English: These positive effects are called ecosystem services, while the negative outcomes are called ecosystem disservices.
Luganda: Emiganyulo gino giyitibwa ebifunibwa mu butonde bw’ensi (ecosystem services), so ng’obuzibu obuvaamu buyitibwa obulabe bw’obutonde bw’ensi.
Yoruba: Àwọn ipa gidi yìí ní wọ́n ń pè ní àwọn ìwúlò ibùgbé ohun abẹ̀mí, nígbà tí wọ́n ń pe àwọn àbájáde burúkú ẹ̀ ní àwọn kùdìẹ̀-kediẹ ibùgbé ohun abẹ̀mí.
Zulu: Le mithelela emihle ibizwa ngezinsizakalo ze-ecosystem, kanti imiphumela engemihle ibizwa nge-ecosystem disservices.
Hausa: Waɗannan ingantattun tasirin ana kiran su ayyuka na tsarin muhalli, a yayin da mummunan sakamako ana kiransa tsarin muhalli na rashin amfani.
Northern Sotho: Diabe tše aone tše di bitšwa ditirelo tša phedišano ya diphedi, mola e le gore dipoelo tše di sego tša loka di bitšwa tlhokego ya ditirelo ka phedišano ya diphedi.
Amharic: እነዚህ አወንታዊ ተጽእኖዎች የስነ-ምህዳር አገልግሎቶች ይባላሉ፤ አሉታዊ ውጤቶቹ ደግሞ የስነ-ምህዳር እንከኖች ይባላሉ።

English: In this study, researchers reviewed the existing knowledge of invasive species in South Africa’s urban areas, to understand how they spread and the impact they have.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza beetegereza beetegereza ebimanyiddwa ku bitonde eby’obulabe mu bitundu by’ebibuga by’e South Africa, okutegeera engeri gye bisaasaanamu n’ebyo bye bireeta.
Yoruba: Nínú ìwádìí yìí, àwọn aṣẹ̀wádìí ṣe àtúnyẹ̀wò ìmọ̀ tó wà nílẹ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀ nípa àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí oníkọlù ní àwọn ìgboro South Africa, láti lóye nípa bí wọ́n ṣe ń tànka àti ipa tí wọ́n ní.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babuyekeze ulwazi olukhona lwezilwane ezihlaselayo ezindaweni zasemadolobheni aseNingizimu Afrika, ukuze baqonde ukuthi zisakazeka kanjani kanye nomthelela ezinawo.
Hausa: A wannan binciken, masu bincike sun sake nazarin ilimin da ake da shi na nau’o’i masu mamayewa a cikin yankunan Afirka ta Kudu, don fahimtar yadda suke yaɗuwa da kuma tasirin da suke da shi.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba ile ba lekodišiša tsebo ye e lego gona ka ga diphedi tše di šwahlelago mafelong ka mafelonga ditoropong a Afrika Borwa, go kwešiša ka fao di phatlalalago ka gona le seabe seo di nago le sona.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ውስጥ ተመራማሪዎች ወራሪ ዝርያዎች እንዴት እንደሚዛመቱ እና የሚኖራቸውን ተጽእኖ ለመረዳት በደቡብ አፍሪካ የከተማ አካባቢዎች ስለሚገኙ ወራሪ ዝርያዎች ያለውን ዕውቀት ገምግመዋል።

English: They also identified some of the challenges that occur when managing invasive species, and suggested strategies for overcoming these problems.
Luganda: Era baazuula okumu ku kusoomoozebwa okubaawo mu nkwata y’ebitonde eby’obulabe, era ne bateesa amakubo g’okuvvuunukamu obuzibu buno.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ṣèdánimọ̀ fún àwọn ìpènijà tí wọ́n kojú nígbà tí wọ́n ṣàkóso àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí oníkọlù, wọ́n sì dábàá àwọn ète àti kojú àwọn ìṣòro wọ̀nyí.
Zulu: Baphinde bahlonza ezinye zezinselele eziba khona lapho kulawulwa izilwane ezihlaselayo, futhi basikisela amasu okunqoba lezi zinkinga.
Hausa: Haka nan kuma sun gano wasu ƙalubalolin da suke faruwa a lokacin da ake sarrafa nau’o’i masu mamayewa kuma sun bayar da shawarar dabarun shawo kan waɗannan matsalolin.
Northern Sotho: Gape ba ile ba hlatha tše dingwe tša ditlhohlo tšeo di diregago ge go laolwa mehuta ya diphedi tšeo di šwahlelago mafelong, gomme ba šišinya mekgwa ya go fenya mathata a.
Amharic: ወራሪ ዝርያዎችን ሲያስተዳድሩ የሚያጋጥሟቸው አንዳንድ ተግዳሮቶችንም ለይተው እነዚህን ችግሮች ለመቅረፍም ስልቶችን ጠቁመዋል።

English: The researchers found that, while South Africa’s urban areas had many of the same invasive species as others around the world, there were also some unique ones.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakizuula nti, newankubadde ebitundu by’ebibuga mu South Africa byalina ebitonde eby’obulabe bino bingi ng’ebitundu ebirala okwetooloola ensi, waaliwo era ebyawukanamu.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà ṣàwárí pé, nígbà tí àwọn ìgboro South Africa ní púpò àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí oníkọlù kan náà pẹ̀lú àwọn ibòmíràn lórílẹ̀-ayé, wọ́n tún ní àwọn míràn tí ò wọ́pọ̀.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathola ukuthi, nakuba izindawo zasemadolobheni zaseNingizimu Afrika zinezinhlobo eziningi zezilwane ezihlaselayo njengezinye emhlabeni wonke, zikhona futhi ezihlukile.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano cewa, a yayin da yankunan biranen Afirka ta Kudu suke da nau’o’i masu mamayewa iri ɗaya kamar sauran ƙasashe a duniya, akwai kuma wasu na musamman.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba utollotše gore, le ge e le gore mafelo a ditoropong a Afrika Borwa a bile le mehuta ye mentši ya diphedi tša go šwahlela go swaa le mafelo a mangwe go ralala le lefase, gape go bile le a mangwe ao a swanago a nnoši.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንደደረሱበት የደቡብ አፍሪካ የከተማ አካባቢዎች በዓለም ዙሪያ እንዳሉት ሌሎች ብዙ ተመሳሳይ ወራሪ ዝርያዎች ነበሯቸው፤ አንዳንድ ልዩ የሆኑም ነበሯቸው።

English: They noted that the invasive species found in high- and low-income areas were often different.
Luganda: Baagamba nti ebitonde eby’obulabe bino ebisangibwa mu bitundu eby’abagagga n’eby’ab’enfuna entono byali bya njawulo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ṣàkọsílẹ̀ pé àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí oníkọlù tí wọ́n rí ní ibùgbé àwọn olówó maa ń ṣábà yàtò sí ti ibùgbé àwọn tálákà.
Zulu: Baphawule ukuthi izinhlobo ezihlaselayo ezitholakala ezindaweni zabantu abahola kancane nabahola kancane zazivame ukuhluka.
Hausa: Sun lura cewa nau’o’i masu mamayewa da ake samu a wurare masu manya da masu ƙaramin ƙarfi sun sha banban.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile gape ba lemoga gore mehuta ya diphedi tša go šwahlela tšeo di hwetšwago ka mafelo a letseno la godimo le a letseno la fase gantši e be e fapana.
Amharic: ከፍተኛ እና ዝቅተኛ ገቢ ባላቸው አካባቢዎች የሚገኙት ወራሪ ዝርያዎች ብዙ ጊዜ የተለዩ መሆናቸውን አስተውለዋል።

English: For example, Guttural Toads, which are originally from Durban, are now also found in Cape Town, usually in high-income areas where there are larger gardens with ponds for them to breed in.
Luganda: Okugeza, obukere obuyitibwa Guttural Toads, mu kusooka obwasangibwanga mu Durban, kati busangibwa ne mu Cape Town, okusingira ddala mu bitundu by’abagagga omubeera ennimiro ennene ezirimu ebidiba mwe buzaalira.
Yoruba: Bí àpẹẹrẹ, àwọn Ọ̀pọ̀lọ́ Ẹlẹ́dùn-ún-àtọ̀fun, tí wọ́n wa gangan láti Durban, ti wá di rírí ní Cape Town, tí wọ́n dẹ̀ ń ṣábà wà ní agbègbè àwọn olówó níbi tí àwọn ọgbà tó tóbi pẹ̀lú pọ́ǹdì wà fún wọn láti sọ di ibùgbé.
Zulu: Isibonelo, amaGuttural Toads, adabuka eThekwini, aseyatholakala naseKapa, ​​ngokuvamile ezindaweni zabantu abahola kakhulu lapho kunezivande ezinkulu ezinamachibi azozalela kuwo.
Hausa: Alal misali, Guttural Toads, waɗanda asalinsu daga Durban ne, yanzu haka ana samun su a Cape Town, yawanci a wuraren da ake samun kuɗaɗen shiga da yawa inda akwai manyan lambuna da tafkunan da za su iya kiwo a ciki.
Northern Sotho: Go fa mohlala, Guttural Toads, tšeo mathomong di tšwago Durban, bjale mo lebakeng le di hwetšagala le ka Cape Town, ka tlwaelo mafelong ao go ona go dulago batho ba letseno la godimo fao go nago le dirapa tše kgolo le matangwana ao di kgonago go ikoketša gona.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ ገተራል ጉርጦች መጀመሪያ ከደርባን የመጡ ሲሆን አሁን በኬፕ ታውን አብዛኛውን ጊዜ የሚራቡባቸው ኩሬዎች የሚኖሩባቸው ትልቅ የአትክልት ስፍራዎች ባሉባቸው የከፍተኛ ገቢ አካባቢዎች ውስጥም ይገኛሉ።

English: They also found that many of the invasive species provided ecosystem services and disservices in different areas.
Luganda: Era baakizuula nti ebitonde eby’obulabe bingi byalina emiganyulo n’obulabe bw’obutonde mu bitundu eby’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ṣàwárí pé púpọ̀ nínú àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí oníkọlù náà ń pèsè ìwúlò àti kùdìẹ̀ kudiẹ fún ibùgbé ohun abẹ̀mí ní oríṣiríṣi agbègbè.
Zulu: Baphinde bathola ukuthi eziningi zezinhlobo ezihlaselayo zihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ze-ecosystem kanye nokungabi nalutho ezindaweni ezahlukene.
Hausa: Haka nan kuma sun gano cewa yawancin nau’o’i masu mamayewa suna bayar da ayyuka da kuma rashin amfani na tsarin muhalli a wurare daban-daban.
Northern Sotho: Ba utllotše gape gore mehuta ya diphedi tša go šwahlela ye mentši e fane ka ditirelo tša phedišano ya diphedi le go dira gore di hlokagale ka mafelong ao a fapanego.
Amharic: ብዙዎቹ ወራሪ ዝርያዎች በተለያዩ አካባቢዎች የስነ-ምህዳር አገልግሎቶችን እና እንከኖችን ሲያቀርቡ እንደነበርም ደርሰውበታል።

English: For example, in low-income areas, invasive trees like Eucalyptus are an important source of firewood and money.
Luganda: Okugeza, mu bitundu eby’abaavu, emiti egy’obulabe nga kalittunsi givaamu nnyo enku ne ssente.
Yoruba: Bí àpẹẹrẹ, ní agbègbè àwọn tálákà, àwọn igi gbèèrú kíá bíi Yukalípútọ́ọ̀sì tó jẹ́ ọ̀nà àti rí igi-ìdáná àti owó ṣe pàtàkì.
Zulu: Isibonelo, ezindaweni zabantu abahola kancane, izihlahla ezihlaselayo njenge Eucalyptus ziwumthombo obalulekile wezinkuni nemali.
Hausa: Alal misali, a yankunan masu ƙarancin kuɗin shiga, bishiyoyi masu mamayewa kamar Eucalyptus tsuhe ne masu mahimmanci na itacen wuta da kuma kuɗi.
Northern Sotho: Go fa mohlala, ka mafelong ao go ona batho ba hwetšago letseno la fase, mehlare ya go šwahlela mafelong ya go swana le Eucalyptus ke methopo ye bohlokwa ya dikgong le tšhelete.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ ዝቅተኛ ገቢ ባላቸው አካባቢዎች እንደ ባህር ዛፍ ያሉ ወራሪ ዛፎች የማገዶ እና የገንዘብ ምንጭ ናቸው።

English: This means that removing them to protect the ecosystem would also have a negative impact on people’s livelihoods.
Luganda: Kino kitegeeza nti okugiggyawo olw’okutaasa obutonde bw’ensi kiba era kijja kukosa obulamu bw’abantu.
Yoruba: Eyí túnmọ̀ sí pé yíyọ wọ́n láti dáàbòbò ibùgbé ohun abẹ̀mí ma nípa burúkú lórí ìgbésí-ayé àwọn èèyàn.
Zulu: Lokhu kusho ukuthi ukuwasusa ukuze kuvikelwe i-ecosystem nakho kuzoba nomthelela omubi ezimpilweni zabantu.
Hausa: Wannan yana nufin cire su domin kare muhallin zai kuma yi mummunan tasiri ga rayuwar mutane.
Northern Sotho: Se se ra gore go e tloša go šireletša phedišano ya diphedi gape go tla ba le seabe seo se sego sa loka go maphelo a batho.
Amharic: ይህ ማለት ስነ-ምህዳሩን ለመጠበቅ እነሱን ማስወገድ በሰዎች ኑሮ ላይ አሉታዊ ተጽእኖ ይኖረዋል ማለት ነው።

English: In some cases a single species, like Jacaranda, has both negative and positive impacts.
Luganda: Mu mbeera ezino, ekitonde eky’ekika ekimu, nga Jacaranda, kiba n’emiganyulo awamu n’obuzibu.
Yoruba: Nìgbà kọ̀ọ̀kan, ẹ̀yà ohun abẹ̀mí kan bíi Jakaráńdà, maa ń ní àwọn ipa burúkú àti rere.
Zulu: Kwezinye izimo uhlobo olulodwa, njengeJacaranda, lunemithelela emibi nemihle.
Hausa: A wasu lokuta nau’i ɗaya kamar Jacaranda yana da duka tasiri mara kyau da kuma mai kyau.
Northern Sotho: Mabakeng a mangwe mohuta o tee wa diphedi, wa go swana le mohlare wa MoJacaranda, o na le bobedi diabe tše kaone le tšeo di sego tše kaone.
Amharic: በአንዳንድ ሁኔታዎች እንደ ጃካራንዳ ያለ አንድ ነጠላ ዝርያ አሉታዊም አወንታዊም ተጽእኖ ይኖሩታል።

English: These trees are highly valued in urban gardens, but cause problems in local ecosystems when their seeds spread to natural areas around the city.
Luganda: Emiti gino gitwalibwa nga gya mugaso nnyo mu nnimiro z’omu bibuga, naye gireeta obuzibu mu butonde bw’eggwanga ensigo gyazo bwe gisaasaana mu bifo by’obutonde mu kibuga.
Yoruba: Àwọn igi yìí wúlò gan-an ní àwọn ọgbà nígboro, ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n maa ń fa wàhálà ní ibùgbé ohun abẹ̀mí ní àwọn agbègbè nígbà tí àwọn irúgbìn wọn bá ń tànká sí àwọn àgbègbè káàkiri ìlu náà.
Zulu: Lezi zihlahla zaziswa kakhulu ezingadini zasemadolobheni, kodwa zibangela izinkinga ku-ecosystem yendawo lapho imbewu yazo isakazekela ezindaweni zemvelo ezizungeze idolobha.
Hausa: Waɗannan bishiyoyi suna da daraja sosai a cikin lambunan birane, amma suna haifar da matsala a cikin tsarin muhalli lokacin da irinsu suka bazu zuwa wurare na halitta a kewayen birni.
Northern Sotho: Mehlare ye e bonwa e le bohlokwa kudu ka dirapeng tša ditoropong, eupša e baka mathata ka phedišanong ya diphedi ge dipeu tša tšona di phatlalala di eya mafelong a tlhago go ralala le toropokgolo.
Amharic: እነዚህ ዛፎች በከተማ የአትክልት ቦታዎች ውስጥ ከፍተኛ ዋጋ አላቸው ነገር ግን ዘራቸው በከተማው ዙሪያ ወደ ተፈጥሯዊ አካባቢዎች ሲሰራጭ በአካባቢው ስነ-ምህዳር ላይ ችግር ይፈጥራሉ።

English: Overall, the researchers say that arguments for how invasive species should be managed are often made based on the ecosystem services and disservices they provide.
